Package index

Reference tables

Journals, agreements and dashboard portfolios, shipped with the package. Every other table joins to them by issn_l or agreement_id.

journals
Journals
journal_issns
Journal ISSNs
agreements
Transformative agreements
agreement_journals
Journals covered by transformative agreements
agreement_institutions
Institutions participating in transformative agreements
portfolios
Dashboard portfolios

Analysis

The same functions run on the Parquet files and on BigQuery.

jn_download()
Download the jnanalytics data
jn_oa() jn_licenses() jn_metadata()
Open access in the journal market
jn_source() jn_tbl()
Connect to the jnanalytics tables

Schema

One schema for column names, types and descriptions, used for validation, the BigQuery column descriptions and the Parquet metadata.

jn_schema()
Column schema of the jnanalytics data model
jn_tables()
Tables in the jnanalytics data model
jn_validate()
Validate a table against the jnanalytics schema

Building the data

Reference tables from the raw JCT and ESAC files, BigQuery tables from the SQL templates in inst/sql, the Parquet export and its upload to Hugging Face. Usually run through the targets pipeline in _targets.R.

jn_update_reference()
Build the reference tables
jn_save_reference()
Save the reference tables as package data
jn_fetch_openalex_sources()
Fetch OpenAlex journal metadata for the JCT journals
jn_upload_reference()
Upload the reference tables to BigQuery
jn_build()
Build all jnanalytics tables in BigQuery
jn_build_table()
Build a table in BigQuery from a SQL template
jn_publish()
Export the published tables as Parquet
jn_publish_tables()
Tables exported by jn_publish()
jn_release()
Describe a release
jn_upload_hf()
Upload a release to Hugging Face

jn_sql()

jn_snapshots()
